name: עַדְרִיאֵל
summary: Adriel the Meholathite marries Saul’s daughter Merab. Samuel also identifies him as a son of Barzillai.

evidence.note: Merab is given to Adriel in marriage.
Adriel’s father and place of origin are supplied in the account of his sons.

note: The proposed reading combines the Aramaic word for help with the divine name element אֵל. Samuel identifies the man without explaining his name.
